callouts.label: AI alt text generation
callouts.hint: A picture frame with lines of text under it.
callouts.description: Mainly raises accessibility. Typical agent mistake: generic text or invented details. The human check: look at each image beside its draft.
callouts.tip: Nothing is applied without human review.

callouts.label: Caption generation
callouts.hint: A screen with two subtitle bars.
callouts.description: Mainly raises accessibility. Typical agent mistake: mis-heard technical terms. The human check: watch the video while reading the captions.
callouts.tip: Nothing is applied without human review.

callouts.label: Heading repair
callouts.hint: Bars at three indent levels, like an outline.
callouts.description: Mainly raises accessibility. Typical agent mistake: renamed or merged sections. The human check: compare the outline before and after.
callouts.tip: Nothing is applied without human review.

callouts.label: Reading level rewrite
callouts.hint: A staircase with a downward arrow.
callouts.description: Mainly raises readability. Typical agent mistake: lost precision or meaning. The human check: run the readability tool and the meaning checks.
callouts.tip: Nothing is applied without human review.

callouts.label: Metadata generation
callouts.hint: A price-tag shape with a hole.
callouts.description: Mainly raises metadata. Typical agent mistake: a guessed author or license. The human check: verify each field against the page.
callouts.tip: Nothing is applied without human review.

callouts.label: License statement repair
callouts.hint: A page with a round seal.
callouts.description: Mainly raises open license. Typical agent mistake: a license assigned to someone else's work. The human check: find the owner's terms or replace the item.
callouts.tip: Nothing is applied without human review.

callouts.label: Chapter splitting
callouts.hint: Scissors cutting a page in two.
callouts.description: Mainly raises modularity. Typical agent mistake: a module that still depends on another. The human check: open each module alone.
callouts.tip: Nothing is applied without human review.

callouts.label: Glossary generation
callouts.hint: A book with a list and a bookmark.
callouts.description: Mainly raises readability. Typical agent mistake: a definition that differs from the resource's use. The human check: compare with the resource and a trusted source.
callouts.tip: Nothing is applied without human review.

callouts.label: Link repair
callouts.hint: Two chain links with a gap and a bridge.
callouts.description: Mainly raises accuracy and currency. Typical agent mistake: an invented address. The human check: open every new link.
callouts.tip: Nothing is applied without human review.

callouts.label: Content update
callouts.hint: A calendar with a circular arrow.
callouts.description: Mainly raises accuracy and currency. Typical agent mistake: a figure from memory. The human check: open the source and confirm the figure.
callouts.tip: Nothing is applied without human review.

callouts.label: PDF-to-Markdown conversion
callouts.hint: A locked page with an arrow to an open page of hash marks.
callouts.description: Mainly raises editable source. Typical agent mistake: lost tables, headings, or pictures. The human check: compare the output with the pdf.
callouts.tip: Nothing is applied without human review.

callouts.label: Practice question generation
callouts.description: Mainly raises practice with feedback. Typical agent mistake: a wrong key or a leading stem. The human check: answer each question without the key.
callouts.tip: Nothing is applied without human review.

callouts.label: MicroSim building
callouts.hint: A window with a slider and a play triangle.
callouts.description: Mainly raises practice with feedback. Typical agent mistake: wrong science or a failed embed. The human check: use every control and embed it on each platform.
callouts.tip: Nothing is applied without human review.
